stories.title: Terra dei Fuochi, 200 milioni in più per le bonifiche. Meloni: “Lavoriamo per salute e sicurezza”

en.title: Terra dei Fuochi, 200 million euros more for remediation. Meloni: "We are working for health and safety"
en.summary: The Italian government approved a decree allocating an additional 200 million euros for environmental remediation in the Terra dei Fuochi region, with Prime Minister Meloni emphasizing the commitment to public health and safety.

stories.title: Spagna: il giorno dopo la sconfitta del governo Sanchez sul decreto casa, continuano le proteste

en.title: Spain: the day after the Sanchez government's defeat on the housing decree, protests continue
en.summary: Demonstrations and marches are taking place in Madrid and 50 other Spanish cities following the government's legislative defeat, while Prime Minister Sanchez considers whether to call early elections.

stories.title: Sinner ancora ai box salta anche il Masters 1000 di Shanghai

en.title: Sinner still sidelined, misses Shanghai Masters 1000 tournament
en.summary: World number one Jannik Sinner will skip the Shanghai Masters 1000 due to ongoing knee issues, with medical professionals describing his condition as a complex knee problem.

stories.title: Meloni, con più fondi per la Terra dei Fuochi lavoriamo per la salute e la sicurezza

en.title: Meloni, with more funds for Terra dei Fuochi we work for health and safety
en.summary: The government aims to simplify and accelerate procedures for remediation interventions in the Terra dei Fuochi area through increased funding.

stories.title: Spagna, centinaia di migliaia in piazza dopo la bocciatura del decreto casa: “Ora sciopero generale”

en.title: Spain, hundreds of thousands in streets after rejection of housing decree: 'Now general strike'
en.summary: Hundreds of thousands protested in Spain following parliamentary rejection of a housing decree. The demonstrations were connected to a housing crisis highlighted by the eviction of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid.

stories.title: Mosca, colpito il ponte nord di Kiev, facilita il movimento delle truppe

en.title: Moscow, northern bridge of Kyiv hit, facilitates troop movement
en.summary: Russia's defense ministry reported striking Kyiv's northern bridge as part of ongoing attacks on military infrastructure and vessels.

stories.title: Spagna in piazza per la casa, 70 mila a Madrid. Gli organizzatori: “Siamo 500 mila. Ora sciopero generale”

en.title: Spain takes to streets over housing, 70,000 in Madrid. Organizers: 'We are 500,000. Now general strike'
en.summary: Large demonstrations took place across Spanish cities over a housing crisis and rental affordability, sparked by the eviction of an elderly woman and rejection of government housing decrees. Strike action was announced as protests continued.

stories.title: Gambetti nuovo arcivescovo di Chieti-Vasto, un profilo del cardinale finora arciprete a San Pietro

en.title: Gambetti new archbishop of Chieti-Vasto, profile of cardinal previously archpriest at St. Peter's
en.summary: A cardinal previously serving as archpriest at St. Peter's Basilica was appointed as the new archbishop of Chieti-Vasto, succeeding Monsignor Bruno Forte.

stories.title: Mauro Gambetti arcivescovo di Chieti-Vasto, il Papa sceglierà un nuovo arciprete per San Pietro

en.title: Mauro Gambetti archbishop of Chieti-Vasto, the Pope will choose a new archpriest for St. Peter's
en.summary: Mauro Gambetti, a 60-year-old member of the Franciscan order, has been appointed archbishop of Chieti-Vasto. He previously served as vicar general for Vatican City and archpriest of St. Peter's Basilica.

stories.title: Via da Roma il cardinale Gambetti: perché Leone manda in Abruzzo il potente arciprete di San Pietro

en.title: Cardinal Gambetti leaves Rome: why Pope sends influential St. Peter's archpriest to Abruzzo
en.summary: Cardinal Gambetti, a Franciscan who increased basilica revenues but faced some concerns, has departed Rome from his key Curia position, which is now vacant.

stories.title: Sinner, ora è allarme. Slitta ancora il rientro: salta anche il Masters 1000 di Shanghai

en.title: Sinner, now there is concern. Return delayed further: Shanghai Masters 1000 also missed
en.summary: World number one Jannik Sinner's absence from competition extends further, with the tennis player missing the Shanghai Masters 1000 after nearly three months without playing.

stories.title: Sinner salta anche Shanghai, il problema al ginocchio non è ancora risolto

en.title: Sinner Withdraws from Shanghai, Knee Problem Remains Unresolved
en.summary: The world's top-ranked player is skipping the Shanghai Masters following his withdrawal from the China Open, sitting out the entire Asian tour with a potential return planned for Vienna on October 24.

stories.title: L’ex fabbrica di rame diventa luogo di cura per più di 100 patologie

en.title: The former copper factory becomes a care facility for more than 100 diseases
en.summary: Dynamo Camp, established in 2007 as a summer facility providing free stays for children with cancer, has evolved over two decades into a treatment center addressing numerous conditions.

stories.title: Posti barca, in Italia sono 172mila ma solo il 2% è dedicato ai superyacht

en.title: Boat berths, Italy has 172,000 but only 2% are dedicated to superyachts
en.summary: Italy has 172,000 boat berths, with only 2% designated for vessels over 24 meters. Liguria and Toscana regions account for approximately half of the superyacht capacity.

stories.title: Sardegna, pastori pronti alla mobilitazione per prezzo del latte e rincari

en.title: Sardinia, shepherds ready for mobilization over milk prices and increases
en.summary: Six hundred representatives from the dairy sector met to discuss conditions they describe as worse than in 2019, signaling preparation for organized action regarding milk pricing and cost increases.

stories.title: Bilancio UE: 17 paesi contro nuovi tagli a Coesione e Agricoltura

en.title: EU Budget: 17 countries oppose new cuts to Cohesion and Agriculture
en.summary: Seventeen EU member states have sent a letter to European leadership ahead of an October 15-16 council meeting to express opposition to proposed reductions in cohesion and agricultural funding within the 2024-2034 budget framework.

stories.title: Puglia, debutta l’aero cargo Taranto Grottaglie per l’agroalimentare del Sud

en.title: Puglia launches cargo air service from Taranto Grottaglie for Southern agricultural products
en.summary: A new cargo airline service has begun operating in Puglia in collaboration with Turkish Airlines, transporting agricultural goods through Istanbul for distribution worldwide.
